related_questions.question: Does COVID come on suddenly or gradually?

text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 symptoms can appear both suddenly and gradually, but generally, they tend to develop over a few days. While some individuals may experience a rapid onset of symptoms, others might notice a gradual progression from mild to more severe illness, especially with new variants. The timeframe for symptom onset after exposure can range from 2 to 14 days.
